verdict.rationale: The docs give a one-line quickstart (`npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`, or `claude`/`codex`/`copilot plugin install`) followed by "type a slash command". A recorded hands-on probe confirms the documented install runs end-to-end without prompts and installs a working `tdd` skill. Engineering skills also need a one-time `setup-matt-pocock-skills` configuration step first. missing for 10: no explicit time-to-first-skill measurement confirming the under-five-minute claim, and no evidence of how long the one-time per-repo setup step takes.
